name: Scale Filter
description: A filter that lets through only the notes of a key and scale, in every octave, so noise, a field recording or a drum loop comes out as a chord.

params.name: Root
params.description: The key note the scale is built on. With Scale and Chord it decides which notes are let through.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The set of notes that pass, counted from Root. Chromatic lets every note of the keyboard through and takes out only what lies between them.

params.name: Chord
params.description: Thins the scale to a chord. Triad keeps its root, third and fifth, Fifths the root and fifth, and Root only one note in every octave.

params.name: Ring
params.description: How long each note goes on sounding after what fed it has stopped. At the bottom the notes stop with the source.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far everything between the notes is turned down. Low only leans towards the key; high leaves nothing but the notes. Zero is the sound as it came.

params.name: Tune
params.description: Moves every note sharp or flat together, to meet a recording that is not at concert pitch. Turned slowly on noise it slides the whole chord.

params.name: Glow
params.description: Lifts the notes to make up for what the filter took away. It never brings them above the level of the sound that came in.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the sound as it came and the filtered notes.

params.name: Opening
params.description: How wide the opening at each note is. Narrow turns anything into pure held tones; wide brings the source back with only the wrong notes dimmed.

params.name: Low
params.description: The lowest note that is let through. Everything under it is turned down by Depth, so raise it to keep the chord out of the bass.

params.name: High
params.description: The highest note that is let through. Everything over it is turned down by Depth, so lower it for a darker chord.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on kit::Stft<8192, 2048>: a mask of bells at the notes of a scale, a partial's measured frequency deciding its gain, and a hold per bin for the ring.
